newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index up, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index up, volume down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed up 0.19 percent on Wednesday in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 447.50 points, up from 446.66 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 365,964 dinars against 5.14 million dinars over the previous session.
Retail stores Monoprix was up 0.7 dinar to 32.2 dinars. Chemical firm Alkimia advanced 0.5 dinar to 41 dinars.
Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie rose 0.5 dinar to 41 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie was up 0.5 dinar to 29.5.
Arab Tunisian Bank fell 0.38 dinar to 25.02 dinars. Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats d'Investissement was down 0.16 dinar to 21.84 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF eased 0.12 dinar to 14.07 dinars.
